body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its new portfolio of ultra-slim Plasma HDTVs with the 8000, 7000 and 6500 Series during Samsung presss conference at CES 2010.
Each provides technologies that deliver exceptional picture quality, advanced connectivity with the updated 'Internet@TV' feature and compliance to revised EnergyStar 4.0 standards.
Additionally, the premium plasma TV line (8000 and 7000 Series) includes Samsung's proprietary built-in 3D processor that adds a new dimension to TV viewing at home.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
